dedupe_keys.name: global gap filled one kilometre surface soil moisture

description: The National Tibetan Plateau/Third Pole Environment Data Center publishes gap-filled global surface-soil-moisture estimates at one-kilometre resolution. The product combines ESA-CCI observations, ERA5 information and random-forest downscaling with ground observations. Its public page gives coverage from 1 February 2000 to 31 December 2020, between 60 degrees south and 85 degrees north. Monthly fields use GeoTIFF; daily fields use HDF5 tiles in a sinusoidal projection. Integer values scale by 0.001 to cubic metres per cubic metre. The 1.17-TB collection is listed as open access and free under CC BY 4.0. It can support irrigation, runoff and vegetation-stress simulations alongside data-era5-reanalysis and model-invest. A caveat is that gap filling and downscaling produce estimates with variable uncertainty. The actual transfer procedure and tile completeness were not tested.
